description: This file defines a custom callback class SwipeToDeleteCallback for implementing swipe-to-delete functionality in a RecyclerView, including visual cues such as background color and delete icon, and handling item removal.

classes.name: SwipeToDeleteCallback
classes.description: A custom ItemTouchHelper.SimpleCallback for handling swipe-to-delete actions with visual feedback.

methods.name: onMove
methods.description: Overrides the onMove method; returns false as move actions aren't handled.

methods.name: onSwiped
methods.description: Handles the swipe action by removing the item at the swiped position from the adapter and announcing deletion.

methods.name: onChildDraw
methods.description: Draws the red background and delete icon during the swipe gesture.
